currency: constant 2026 USD; no inflation, tax or terminal value
geography: US illustrative deployment pool; no national extrapolation
denominator: Each cell contains 12 synthetic sites. Accepted service units differ across cells. Only baseline-equivalent human hours are additive across cells; they are not employment or payroll.

cells.label: Manufacturing · assembly feeding
cells.physical_fit: bounded parts and fixtures; does not model general assembly

cells.label: Logistics · tote handoffs
cells.specialized_fit: conveyor or AMR with standard transfer stations

cells.label: Facilities · floor cleaning
cells.physical_fit: accessible floors; humanoid system is a scenario candidate only

cells.label: Healthcare · hospital logistics
cells.physical_fit: nonclinical supplies; infection and access controls assumed satisfied
cells.specialized_fit: AMR on accessible routes with human loading

cells.label: Construction · installation support
cells.physical_fit: high variability; fit threshold excludes many illustrative sites
cells.specialized_fit: lift equipment plus human crew; no autonomous installation claim

cells.label: Utilities · condition inspection
cells.physical_fit: ground route sensing; human review and repair retained
cells.specialized_fit: fixed sensing where the observation points are covered

incumbent.label: Incumbent, routine approval
incumbent.explanation: Scenario: approval delay, 10 of 12 sites under process authority, local cash ceiling and annual implementation slots.

constrained.label: Incumbent, constrained site authority
constrained.explanation: Scenario: lower cash and implementation capacity plus narrower authority; ownership label itself has no multiplier.

integrated.label: Integrated operating organization
integrated.explanation: Scenario: unified workflow authority, cash allowance and engineering slots. No causal ownership effect is inferred.

prompt_response.label: Entrant service contract; immediate incumbent response

assumptions.description: 12 constructed site cohorts per cell, one target robot per site, deterministic heterogeneous thresholds; no national market calibration.
Accepted quality is fixed. Capability is an uncalibrated threshold index, not a benchmark score. Unserved work remains human-led. New installations have half-year productive exposure.

Qualified component receipts are net of outside commitments and upstream yield. H and Q actuators are incompatible. Only a hypothetical common embedded LPDDR board pool is shared; HBM/training resources are outside this pool.
Assembly takes one annual period; accepted systems can ship on completion; commissioning takes one further period. Fractional flows are deterministic expected units, not a discrete factory schedule.
Each start consumes its full BOM; final assembly yield applied once at completion. Rejected units have no salvage. No upstream yield or scrap deduction is repeated.

Annual non-revolving customer/provider funding envelopes; capital is reserved at shipment. Cash generated does not automatically expand those envelopes. Annual resource cost uses straight-line capital consumption, while separate cash views count investments at deployment.

Transfer default is zero (no assumed transfer, not evidence of observed zero). Optional within-system directed transfer changes future capability after exposure and validation cost; no separate data-value premium.

Entrant standalone project uses the same unit technology and commercial terms as incumbent. Funding is an assumed equity commitment, not evidence of availability. Entry demand capture is explicit, with price response, ramp, and share conservation.

Only the explicitly assumed labor_avoidability fraction of released labor value is treated as avoided cash for customer eligibility/payback. Default 0.75 is not an observed payroll result. Matched resource-cost tables value all released time; observed payroll removed remains null.
